WHAT: Two Prisma gotchas for Fashion Finder
1. DB location: schema.prisma says `url = file:./dev.db` — this resolves relative to CWD (project root), so the actual DB is at /Users/ned/Desktop/Projects/vinted-fashion-finder/dev.db, NOT prisma/dev.db
2. Client caching: After running `prisma generate` or `prisma db push`, the running Next.js dev server (Turbopack) keeps old client in memory. Must delete .next/ folder AND restart server.
FIX: `rm -rf .next && npm run dev` after any schema changes
GOTCHA: prisma/dev.db path does NOT exist — the file is at root. If prisma/dev.db is 0 bytes, server will hang on all DB queries.
